name: Rogue Daring Scoundrel
body:
Joining the audacious deeds of a swashbuckler with the subtle mobility of legendary thefts, a daring scoundrel is a romantic figure, a smiling shadow that robs the rich of their most cherished treasures, and youths or maidens of their hearts.

Fencer (Ex)

At 1st level, the daring scoundrel gains finesse rogue as a bonus rogue talent.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Daring (Ex)

At 2nd level, a daring scoundrel must take the panache rogue talent (see above). She may regain panache through critical hits and killing blows scored with her sneak attack ability, other than with normal means.

Deeds

A daring scoundrel can choose any swashbuckler deed in place of a rogue talent. She must meet the chosen deeds’ prerequisites.

Social Animal

At 3rd level, and every 4 levels thereafter, a daring scoundrel gains one vigilante social talent chosen among the following: case the joint, gossip collector, great renown, incredible renown, intrigue feats, loyal aid, obscurity , renown, safe house, social grace, triumphant return. The daring scoundrel is always considered to be in her “social identity” for the purpose of these talents.

This replaces trap sense.

Rogue Talents

The following rogue talents complement the daring scoundrel archetype: acrobatic stunt, climbing stunt, convincing lie, obfuscate story, offensive defense, positioning attack, powerful sneak, steal story, and weapon training.

Advanced Talents

The following advanced rogue talents complement the daring scoundrel archetype: crippling strike, entanglement of blades, redirect attack, and unwitting ally.
